title: Whole-image comparison
summary: The features above combined. Same seed, v1 against v2 shows the overall change; the ablation sheet switches each flag on alone; the 3x3 grid shows how varied v2 scenes are. FLIP_PROB = 0.30 applies to the v2 mines in the whole-image pictures (so about a third are face down) except in the ablation sheet, where mines are fixed face up.
how: render_scene(seed, overrides): v1 uses {'v1': True} (every flag off, v1 post shader); the ablation uses {'only': [FLAG]}. Each subsystem draws from its own random stream so a flag changes only its own feature.
code: DatasetGenerator/scene.py: render_scene; config.py: make_config (v1 / only); scripts/visual_check.py

options.label: per-feature ablation sheet
options.params: seed 12, only=[FLAG] for each of ASSET_AUDIT_FILTER, NEW_ASSETS, LEAF_CLUMPS_NEW, GRASS_BLADES, MESH_MINES, SOFT_EDGES, SHADOWS, SOIL_BLEND, BURIAL, COLOUR_PALETTE, PHOTOMETRIC_JITTER, BLUR, BG_AUGMENT, LABEL_VISIBLE_MASK
options.caption: Each tile enables one flag alone on top of the v1 pipeline (top-left = v1, last = everything). Features that need the mesh (burial, colour palette, mesh shadows) do little without MESH_MINES, as documented.

options.label: leave-one-out ablation sheet
options.params: seed 12, everything on except the named flag
options.caption: More informative than the only-one sheet: first tile is full v2, each other tile removes one feature. Turning NEW_ASSETS off or BG_AUGMENT off changes the background photo itself, so those tiles look different overall.

options.label: 3x3 grid of v2 scenes
options.caption: Nine unrelated v2 images at 460 px per tile: different ground, light, clutter and mines.

before_after.label: v1 vs v2, seed 5
before_after.caption: Full frame at 2/3 size. v2: shadows consistent with one sun, varied mine colours, soil blending, grass blades, jitter.

before_after.label: v1 vs v2, seed 9
before_after.caption: Full frame at 2/3 size. v2: shadows consistent with one sun, varied mine colours, soil blending, grass blades, jitter.

notes: The v1 and v2 images share a seed, not a scene: v1 mode picks its backgrounds from the v1 pool and the v2 sampler differs, so the ground and mines are not identical. Per-flag ablation images keep the same random streams, so they are directly comparable. The ablation uses 3 mines at fixed positions, burial 35% for visibility and FLIP_PROB 0 (mines face up). In the only-one sheet, the NEW_ASSETS tile (and the all-on tile) draw a different background photo because that flag changes the background pool, so compare mines rather than ground there.
